discrepancies.dimension: Multi-Pair Cashflow Serialization vs Chronological Execution
discrepancies.evidence: In walk_forward_runner.py, trade cashflows were appended pair-by-pair rather than sorted chronologically by exit_time_ms. In Strategy B, chronological exit-time MDD is 17.1524%, whereas pair-concatenated MDD was reported as 14.8910%. The 15.0% hurdle was crossed in true chronological time.
discrepancies.impact: Strategy B's continuous chronological cashflow MDD breaches GATE-1 (17.15% > 15.0%). However, Strategy B already failed GATE-2, GATE-3, GATE-7, and GATE-8 in Phase 4B, so the global certified decision remains NO_QUALIFIED_STRATEGY. Strategy B remains the UNQUALIFIED_BASELINE.
discrepancies.recommended_action: Implement a true multi-pair event queue in the Phase 5 ML backtest engine that merges all trade fills and cashflows strictly by timestamp (exit_time_ms).

discrepancies.dimension: Independent Isolated Sub-Accounts vs Shared Portfolio Margin
discrepancies.evidence: Each of the 10 pairs was executed in an isolated backtest engine initialized with $10,000 cash. Total deployed simulation capital across the 10 pairs was $100,000 ($10,000 x 10). During peak hours, up to 10 pairs held open positions simultaneously ($10,161 peak notional). Position sizing in each pair reflected only that pair's local balance, without shared margin contention.
discrepancies.impact: The reported $10,000 portfolio equity curve is a synthetic normalization convention, not a physically constrained shared-margin account. If gross leverage had exceeded 1.0x or if cash had become negative in one pair, the other pairs would not have been impacted.
discrepancies.recommended_action: Explicitly document the current model as '10 Independent Sub-Accounts Normalized to $10k'. Build a unified centralized portfolio margin coordinator in Phase 5 to support cross-instrument margin sharing.

discrepancies.evidence: Strategy A reported an MDD of 272.65% because cumulative losses (-$27,264.91) accumulated continuously on a synthetic $10,000 base without a zero-equity floor. In an isolated executable account, capital is liquidated at 100% loss ($0.00 equity).
discrepancies.impact: Reporting 272.65% MDD accurately reflects cumulative unconstrained strategy drag (2.72x capital loss), but violates standard portfolio risk conventions where max drawdown cannot exceed 100%.
discrepancies.recommended_action: Provide both un-clamped strategy drag (272.65%) and clamped bankruptcy drawdown (100.0%) in risk analytics.

discrepancies.dimension: Fold Cash Reset Inconsistency in Combined MDD
discrepancies.evidence: Each OOS fold initialized engines with a fresh $10,000 cash reset, but the overall OOS MDD was calculated by compounding trade cashflows continuously across all 3 folds without resetting equity at fold boundaries. In Fold 3 alone, Strategy B suffered an independent chronological drawdown of 18.74%.
discrepancies.impact: Trade notionals in Fold 3 were sized off a local $10,000 base, but accumulated in the combined curve on top of Fold 1 and 2 profits ($12,721 HWM). Evaluating folds independently reveals that Fold 3 exceeded the 15% risk budget.
discrepancies.recommended_action: Report per-fold MDD alongside combined multi-fold MDD, and enforce that candidate strategies must pass the MDD hurdle in every individual fold as well as combined.

methodology_answers.finding_A_equity_series: The reported MDD was computed strictly from trade-close cashflows (t.net_pnl in trade_ledger.json). It did NOT use bar-by-bar candle-marked mark-to-market equity. Intrabar excursions were excluded.
methodology_answers.finding_B_chronology_and_positions: Simultaneous trades were NOT processed chronologically in the runner. Trades were concatenated pair-by-pair within each fold. When recomputed chronologically by exit time, Strategy B MDD rises from 14.89% to 17.15%.
methodology_answers.finding_C_capital_allocation: The simulation allocated $10,000 independently to each of the 10 pairs ($100,000 total capital). The $10,000 portfolio curve is a synthetic normalization convention. Each pair traded ~10% notional ($1,000), and simultaneous positions averaged 2.8-3.8 pairs, peaking at 10 pairs ($10,161 peak notional / 1.02x leverage).
methodology_answers.finding_D_fold_reset_and_mdd: Folds reset to $10,000 cash in the engine, but the combined MDD compounded cashflows continuously. Fold-specific exit-time MDD was 12.43% (Fold 1), 12.63% (Fold 2), and 18.74% (Fold 3). Fold 3 breached the 15% hurdle.
methodology_answers.finding_E_reproduction_status: Strategy B reported MDD of 14.89% is EXACTLY REPRODUCED as 14.8910% from existing saved artifacts. Status: VERIFIED_FROM_CODE_AND_ARTIFACTS.
methodology_answers.finding_F_strategy_a_mdd_interpretation: Strategy A's 272.65% MDD measures cumulative unhedged strategy drag across 10 unconstrained streams. It is not a realistic single-account executable metric. Under a physical zero-floor, MDD is clamped at 100.0%.
methodology_answers.finding_G_qualification_gate_verdict: No revision of the historical Phase 4B outcome is required. All 3 candidates remain unqualified. The certified global decision remains NO_QUALIFIED_STRATEGY.
